enrichment_playbook.content: Sales Ops Enrichment Playbook v3. Steps: (1) Pull current Salesforce lead. (2) Locate matching LinkedIn profile. (3) Reconcile title, headcount, and role-change data. (4) Compile an enrichment summary listing each proposed field change. (5) Route summary to manager for approval. (6) Only after sign-off: update Salesforce, send outreach, and enroll in sequence. Never skip step 5.
